# Fate UI v0.9.1-beta2

This prerelease improves local voice transcription reliability and fixes macOS in-app updates.

## Faster, bounded local voice input

- Live Parakeet transcription now batches delayed microphone PCM in capture order. A normal stop drains every accepted sample before finalization, rather than waiting behind many small native calls.
- Renderer-to-main and main-to-native queues have explicit 2-second feed bounds and a 10-second total backlog limit. If a computer cannot keep up continuously, Fate UI stops with a clear error instead of retaining unbounded audio or appearing to transcribe forever.
- Batch transcription keeps its existing model warming and GPU policy, while avoiding redundant PCM copies when decoded audio is already mono 16 kHz or has just been resampled.
- Parakeet remains on the stable CPU path on macOS; this release does not re-enable its known-unstable Metal streaming path. Batch models still select their normal accelerator when supported.

## macOS updates

- In-app updates no longer assume that the app bundle inside a downloaded DMG has one fixed name. The updater discovers and validates the staged `.app` bundle before it replaces the installed Fate UI bundle.

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, 128 Vitest files / 1124 tests, and production build passed.
- GitHub Actions run [31753594431](https://github.com/Master0fFate/pi-fategui/actions/runs/31753594431) passed on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64.
- The opt-in packaged native smoke ran both Parakeet streaming and the small batch model on each target, then installed or mounted the platform artifacts successfully.

## Notes

- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
